finiteSchedule.extension: Only extend the predeclared same frozen contract and keep every initial block; no result-driven production tuning and no claim30 guarantees noninferiority. Any input/metric/code change starts a new version and its own fresh formal blocks.
finiteSchedule.parallelism: Original and port may run on separate owned instances; all CPU/MSPT/network/persistence/long-duration work has exclusive turbo1 windows. No performance conclusion from behavior turbo.

analysis.binary: Report numerator/denominator and descriptive Wilson intervals for actual comparable binary outcomes. Safety harm/duplication/permission violations have no tolerated count.
analysis.paired: Keep each JVM-block paired difference; block bootstrap or an explicitly documented paired interval clusters all actors/frames by independent JVM block. Do not bootstrap individual ticks as independent trials.
analysis.latency: Report finite observed times plus censored/untriggered counts, not success-only median without denominator.
analysis.noninferiority: NOT_EVALUATED without approved margin; delta remains null. Intervals/insufficient evidence are useful outputs and do not require the user to accept regression.
